verified_custody: Primary official public sites checked for listed facts; decisions, agendas and outcome completeness NOT independently verified

meeting_notice.rule: same-day recheck through meeting, followed by minute/record reconciliation

budget_active.rule: 7 days during budget/appropriation cycles; verify at every material decision

incident.rule: 5-60 minutes while active; 6-24 hours post stabilization (this edition has no live emergency feed)

historical.rule: retain permanently with provenance, check metadata annually

weekly_digest.rule: editorial refresh targeted every Friday; TTLs for individual items override newsletter cadence

records.heading: City Council regular meeting
records.display_when: Monday, November 23, 2026 · check official page for start and participation details
records.what: The City lists a November 23 Council meeting; its official on-demand portal also lists a regular session. This record does not confirm the final agenda, any proposed ordinance, or a vote.
records.why: Residents can check the posted packet, agenda revisions, livestream and subsequent minutes before interpreting a decision.
records.before: Read the official agenda when posted, identify agenda item IDs, ask about public-comment procedures and submit questions by any posted deadline.
records.after: Reconcile the video, final minutes, voting record, ordinance versions, contracts and implementation updates. Do not count first readings as final passage.
records.uncertainty: Detailed agenda, exact start time, public comment procedure and votes not verified by this brief.

records.heading: Pueblo Water Board meeting
records.agency: Board of Water Works of Pueblo
records.what: Pueblo Water’s official board page lists a monthly meeting at the Alan Hamel Administration Building, 319 W. 4th Street, third floor.
records.why: Water supply, infrastructure and governance decisions can affect households, rates, projects and long-term capacity, but this notice does not establish an agenda item.
records.before: Check for the specific agenda and meeting participation details. Prepare a source-backed question about a water issue that affects you.
records.after: Look for minutes and adopted decisions; follow up on any documented utility project and its implementation stage.
records.uncertainty: Agenda topics and decisions not verified. Linked issue records are contextual, not confirmed meeting items.

records.heading: 10th Judicial District Crime Victim Compensation Board
records.what: The Pueblo County events calendar lists a meeting at 701 Court Street, Gus Sandstrom Conference Room.
records.why: Provides a way to find official public meeting information; do not infer that any individual case or private victim record is public.
records.before: Use the public notice and agenda for the exact scope; do not submit private victim details to Q Pueblo.
records.after: Check only released public governance materials, keeping protected cases and individuals out of the index.
records.uncertainty: This digest does not certify meeting outcome or access to confidential case information.

records.heading: County hearing officer meeting cancelled
records.display_when: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 · previously listed at 6:00 p.m.
records.what: The County’s official calendar marks the liquor and marijuana hearing officer meeting CANCELLED. This is a cancellation notice, not a meeting invitation.
records.why: A changed schedule matters when people plan travel, comments or evidence submissions.
records.before: Do not rely on an older listing. Check the County calendar for a replacement date and relevant licensing process.
records.after: Follow the official page for any rescheduling; don't invent a new hearing date.

records.heading: 2027 City budget: follow proposal versus adoption
records.display_when: Active budget watch · next official document check by November 20, 2026
records.what: The City Finance Department lists its 2027 Proposed Budget. This is an official document source for studying the proposal; this digest does not certify an adopted 2027 budget or changed line items.
records.why: Residents can compare proposed spending, restricted funding, revenue assumptions, staffing, reserves and any subsequent adopted revisions.
records.before: Retrieve the actual proposed tables and amendments; identify public hearing and comment procedures from current official meeting notices.
records.after: Compare legally adopted final amounts, amendments, implementation and reconciled payments. Preserve different fiscal years.
records.uncertainty: The linked FISC-002 index concerns 2026 fiscal pressures and is contextual, not identical to the 2027 proposal.

records.heading: November 9 Council meeting: reconcile the record
records.what: The City's official on-demand archive lists an agenda and a recorded November 9 regular session. The digest has not independently extracted or adjudicated every vote.
records.why: This is the point to compare published agenda items with actual votes, final instruments and implementation responsibility.
records.before: Use item IDs and original agenda language rather than a paraphrase alone.
records.after: Check the recording, signed final instruments, updated minutes, amendments and future re-reads. Mark still-pending items accordingly.
records.uncertainty: Not a vote ledger. All claimed outcomes require item-level verification.

records.heading: PURA November 10 meeting: look for actions and minutes
records.what: PURA's official minutes-and-agendas page lists the November 10, 2026 board meeting book and agenda-setting materials.
records.why: Urban renewal agreements, projects and financial commitments require documentation of what was considered and what was actually adopted.
records.before: Read the meeting book and identify agenda references; distinguish presentations from authorizations.
records.after: Look for posted minutes, recorded votes, executed agreements, and funding milestones; do not presume an outcome from the meeting book.
records.uncertainty: Vote results and current project state not confirmed by this specific official-source check.

records.heading: Next Pueblo County commissioners schedule
